filter_note: The Overview filter uses any reported shock (R2A). A household can appear under more than one shock. Coping route is the household’s overall route, not specific to the selected shock. The coping-by-main-shock chart uses main shock (R2B) and always shows all main-shock groups.
weight_note: household_weight supports survey-weighted shares within this FinAccess 2024 analysis sample. No strata/PSU identifiers are available here, so figures are point estimates represented by the survey — not design-based intervals or an official national headcount.
